title: Launch Sprint Activation Checklist — Catalog, Benchmarks, Docs, and Comms
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Sprint-level activation checklist for bringing a new model into Redwood's catalog and go-to-market. This ticket centralizes operational steps for product, eng, design, and GTM so the model ships with clear benchmarks, accurate docs, console/SDK support, and coordinated external comms.
checklist: Catalog entry: finalize metadata (model size, architecture, tokenizer, quantization status, compatible runtimes)
Catalog entry: attach model artifact links and validation hashes; include recommended default runtime and quant profiles
Benchmarks: run P50/P95 latency, tokens/sec, memory profile on hosted and Dedicated configurations
Benchmarks: compute cost-per-1M-tokens estimates across hosted, dedicated, and quantized variants
Benchmarks: generate benchmark summary (one-pager) and benchmark dataset samples used
Evals: attach representative prompt sets and known failure cases to regression suite
Docs: create API usage examples (text generation, chat, embeddings if applicable) for SDKs (Python, Node)
Docs: update Console model page copy and screenshots (input settings, sample responses, telemetry placement)
Release notes: draft internal release notes and public release note blurb (what changed, recommended use cases, caveats)
SDK & CLI: add/update model alias in SDKs, include migration tips and sample code snippets
Console flags: coordinate feature-flag rollout for new model visibility and allowlist for beta customers
Observability: enable model-specific dashboards (latency, error rate, cost) and create alert thresholds
Rollout plan: define canary cohort, metrics to monitor during canary, and automatic rollback thresholds
Security/Compliance: confirm KMS/HSM behavior for private deployments and include audit log entries
GTM: prepare marketing one-pager, blog draft, and announcement timeline; align on embargo if required
Support: create internal FAQ and triage guide for anticipated issues; link to runbook for degraded-fallbacks
Post-launch: schedule 48h and 2-week post-mortem checkpoints to capture lessons and metric regressions
